notes: New DCL06-C labels: every key that aurora-lint ca6fd5f3f (0.6.0) reports for DCL06-C at the default and strict presets at the pinned commits that is in scope under data/benchmark_repos.json and was not already labeled (118 keys: hostap 63, sqlite 19, valkey 16, mbedtls 6, mosquitto 6, curl 5, raylib 2, sel4 1). They appear because that build reads f and F in a hexadecimal constant as digits; earlier builds stripped them as a float suffix, which silently exempted literals such as 0x0f, 0x1f, 0x3f and 0x7f. Every key was read at source in the pinned checkout (corpus-check: all heads at their pins). They were judged under rulings/rules/DCL06-C.md with the reading calibrated in delta-dcl06c-2026-10-curl-mbedtls-sqlite and applied across the 2026-10 hostap and valkey DCL06-C batches: the oracle labels strict (P/oracle-scope); strict is the presumption with no exempt set (DCL06-C/2026-10-07/form, /presets); EX1 applies only where the constant is itself the abstraction. Bit masks, field extractions, protocol field values and comment-documented values are TP. 115 TP, 3 FP: one element of a const-qualified table initializer and one const-qualified object initializer (each the naming site), and one EX1 boundary ladder (countLeadingZeros, the same shape as the digits10 power-of-ten ladder labeled EX1 in valkey). Five rows conflict with neighbouring carried-forward FP labels on the same value written in hexadecimal, which predate the 2026-10-07 rulings and exempted self-evident or documented masks; each conflict is named in that row's provenance. No prior row is edited. A fresh-context review re-read a sample.
